items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I lived with my grandparents, my mother’s parents, Reverend and Mrs. Simmons.

ctx.x: But my father moving around a lot, so I lived with my grandparents, my mother’s parents, Reverend and Mrs. Simmons. And he was an AME, African Methodist Episcopal minister. And more often than not you didn’t stay longer than seven years in any place. So at that time we were in New York City up at 116th and Madison at Mt. Zion AME church. It’s still there as a matter of fact. And by 1953 we moved to Newport, Rhode Island.
